description: A lab-local insecure deserialization: the session endpoint unserializes an attacker-supplied object without integrity checks.

evidence.notes: Crafted blob changed the restored object from a guest session to an admin session; the object-state change is the proof, not the 200 alone
evidence.response: 200 OK, session restored as the lab admin user

impact: An attacker could forge a serialized session object and act as the lab admin user.
proof_of_concept: POST /lab/session/restore with a crafted serialized blob restores the session as the lab admin user.
remediation: Sign session blobs with a server-side key and reject unsigned or unexpected object types.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the lab session restore endpoint
Submit a crafted serialized blob for an admin session
Observe the restored session acting as the lab admin user
title: Insecure deserialization in lab session restore
